price_source: team model config, USD per million tokens, 2026-11-14
notebook: Reward=(rev-cost)/439; revenue=flow*price*2.88e7. Empty=0.000. Full perfect separation revenue cap = $3611M/yr. But every column costs $150-370M/yr and full separation needs ~15 columns => cost ~$3-4B >> revenue. So over-separating is fatal. Blends are the key lever: C4mix $186M(144mol/s), C5mix ~$618M(695), C6par $1182M(970), C6naph $396M(269) if 95% pure, no separation of members needed. My 4-column cascade got revenue $292M (one C5mix) vs cost $1045M => -1.717. LESSON: cost scales with stages*reflux; the feed column at 40/5 costs $294M alone. UGLY TRUTH: 95% purity needs very sharp cuts; moderate columns leak too much (agent-4 30/3 -> BT only 46% C5). Remaining 10 solves: try ONE configuration that sacrifices completeness for cheapness - a single small column capturing the biggest easy blend, then finish. Note 95% blend purity is likely unreachable in one cheap column, so realistically best score may be ~0. Guard remaining solves.
